description: Implementation of SRS (Sounding Reference Signal) resource allocation logic for a wireless communication system, including slot management, resource creation, and configuration handling.

classes.name: srs_allocator_impl
classes.description: Class responsible for managing SRS resource allocation, including slot indication, resource reservation, and configuration handling.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates the current slot and clears previous SRS usage.

methods.name: allocate_aperiodic_srs
methods.description: Allocates an aperiodic SRS resource for a UE in a specific slot.

methods.name: alloc_srs_resource
methods.description: Marks a specific resource as allocated in the slot.

methods.name: get_slot_idx
methods.description: Calculates the slot index within a TDD period.
